provider_terminal.message: Text transfer failed with exit code 1
provider_terminal.basis: FunctionCall.get(timeout=0) returned the custom remote SandboxTransportError; the foreground worker log retains the remote traceback.

operation: Write prescribed eval_prompt_format.txt before turn51 editor admission
cause: Undetermined. The failed text helper did not retain stderr; the sandbox was later terminated. Exit137 at terminal poll alone does not establish OOM.
mitigation: Leased UTF-8 text writes reuse the existing bounded SHA-verified atomic binary artifact receiver, with the existing1MiB limit and per-operation lease guards.
recovery: Resume the same attempt from saved state; preserve conversation, journals, files, edits, counters and costs. The recreated kernel receives the existing neutral restart notice.
